landing.hero_title: AI-Powered Personal Farming Assistant for Kerala Farmers
landing.hero_subtitle: Equipping smallholder farmers across all 14 districts with localized weather intelligence, early crop disease diagnosis, real-time market prices, and native Malayalam AI advisory.
landing.features_subtitle: Engineered to address the unique agricultural challenges of Kerala — from tropical monsoon variations to plantation cash crop security.
landing.feat_ai_desc: Bilingual conversational intelligence providing context-aware guidance on crop care, fertilizers, organic methods, and government schemes.
landing.feat_weather_desc: District-level microclimate forecasts with actionable agricultural advisories to protect crops from sudden downpours and humidity spikes.
landing.feat_health_desc: Vision-assisted diagnosis for Kerala-specific crop afflictions like Mahali in Arecanut, Quick Wilt in Pepper, and Sigatoka in Banana.
landing.feat_market_desc: Transparent price tracking across Kerala agricultural markets for spices, coconut, natural rubber, and vegetables.
landing.feat_farm_desc: Organized records of your plots, crop cycles, irrigation tasks, and yield history tailored for smallholders.
landing.kerala_focus_desc: Kerala's farming ecology is distinct from generic mainland farming — dominated by high-value spices, plantation estates, wetland paddy (such as Kuttanad), and homestead mixed cropping.
landing.kerala_crops_list: Coconut • Nendran Banana • Black Pepper • Cardamom • Natural Rubber • Wetland Paddy • Arecanut • Nutmeg
landing.cta_banner_title: Ready to experience modern agricultural technology?
landing.cta_banner_desc: Explore the Phase 1 interactive dashboard and preview the next generation of farmer-first AI assistance.

dashboard.title: Farmer Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Daily agricultural overview and advisory briefing
dashboard.sample_advisory: Moderate to heavy rain expected across High Range slopes. Delay copper oxychloride spray on pepper vines until clear skies.
dashboard.rec_1_desc: Recommended application of micronutrient mixture for high-yield hybrid palms this week.
dashboard.rec_2_desc: Provide bamboo supports to bunches nearing harvest ahead of anticipated gusty evening winds.
dashboard.rec_3_desc: Check for Brown Plant Hopper (BPH) signs in waterlogged paddy basins.
dashboard.alert_action: Recommended: Spray 1% Bordeaux mixture on lower leaves on dry morning.
dashboard.task_fertilizer: Apply cow dung slurry to ginger beds
dashboard.task_pest: Inspect rubber trees for powdery mildew
dashboard.task_harvest: Harvest mature Nendran bunches for market
dashboard.ai_quick_subtitle: Instant answers for Kerala farmers in Malayalam and English

modules.ai_assistant_subtitle: Bilingual conversational intelligence powered by Gemini LLM with agricultural knowledge retrieval (RAG).
modules.weather_subtitle: District-level microclimate data and agro-meteorological advisories from India Meteorological Department (IMD).
modules.crop_health_subtitle: Computer vision model trained to classify tropical crop pathogens from leaf photographs.
modules.market_prices_subtitle: Live market rates across Kerala APMC mandis, VFPCK, and Agmarknet portals.
modules.my_farm_subtitle: Digital ledger for plot boundaries, soil health records, crop rotation history, and input tracking.
modules.settings_subtitle: Configure interface language, default district, notifications, and offline preferences.
